purpose: Decide which inferred pass-through corridors are safe to promote into explicit service.accessSegments.

decisionSummary.corridor: Route 2 / Red Band: Port of Spain ↔ Sangre Grande / Arima direction
decisionSummary.reason: Current dataset has strong endpoint/corridor evidence, but not enough explicit intermediate stop-order and safe-stopping evidence around San Juan to promote inferred pass-through access into declared accessSegments.
decisionSummary.routingPosture: Keep using conservative inferred pass-through access through the routing safety gates. Treat San Juan pass-through as estimated until field or association confirmation is collected.
neededEvidence: Association or driver confirmation that westbound Route 2 maxis accept boarding/alighting along the San Juan / Eastern Main Road segment
Exact safe pickup/drop-off zone names or junctions
Direction-specific notes for Port of Spain-bound and eastbound travel
Current fare and operating pattern if available

decisionSummary.corridor: Route 3 / Green Band: Chaguanas ↔ San Fernando
decisionSummary.reason: The southbound service already includes multiple corridor communities in stopNodeIds and has rider/press evidence for intermediate Southern Main Road communities. This is a stronger candidate than Route 2 for explicit segment promotion, though current safe pickup points still need local confirmation before raising confidence above inferred/reported.
decisionSummary.routingPosture: Prefer explicit segments only if each segment remains confidence-labeled and safety-evidence-gated. Do not mark as official stops.

decisionSummary.corridor: Route 4 / Black Band: San Fernando ↔ Princes Town
decisionSummary.reason: The service includes named intermediate communities and fare-stage evidence. This is a good candidate for explicit accessSegments once stop order and pickup safety language are validated.
decisionSummary.routingPosture: Treat as corridor-stage access, not surveyed stops.

guardrail: Do not promote inferred pass-through behavior into explicit accessSegments unless the source supports direction, segment order, and safe stopping evidence. Explicit does not mean official; confidence must remain association_confirmed, community_verified, reported, or inferred_from_route_shape as appropriate.
